about: The path map `tests/suite.py --changed [BASE]` selects test modules by (SPD-234).
Every path changed against the merge base of BASE and HEAD, tracked or untracked and not ignored, is matched against
`full` first and then against each rule in order, the first match deciding; a pattern is an fnmatch pattern over the
path from the repository root, and its `*` crosses `/`.  A path in `full`, or in no rule at all, runs the full suite.
A rule's `modules` are test module names or fnmatch patterns over them (`test_hooks*` takes every module SPD-231
split tests/test_hooks.py into), expanded against the tree the run covers.  With `importers`, the rule also runs
the changed file's own module when it is a test module, and every test module that imports it, directly or through
another, read from the tree's import statements.
Until the fixture ticket (SPD-233) lands, bin/ and share/ have two safe rules, shell and probes, from the audit of
2026-09-23; everything else under bin/ or share/ runs the full suite.  Widen this map by that ticket's dependency
